_comment: Outside skill/agent libraries the AIBAST Agents Library aggregates.
Adding a source is a config edit — scripts/crawl_skills.py reads this file.
LICENSE IS RESOLVED, NOT DECLARED. The crawler asks the origin's own host
what the license is (GitHub's license API) on every run and records the
answer with its source URL. A hand-written license field would go stale and
could be wrong in the direction that matters, so there isn't one.
A source whose license cannot be resolved, or resolves to something
incompatible, stays INDEX-ONLY: metadata and a link, never content.
A permissive, resolved license unlocks conversion into a RAPP single file,
which is redistributed WITH attribution and the upstream license text.

sources.license_note: Resolved at crawl time from the GitHub license API — never hand-asserted.
